item.title: Kiki Shepard, ‘Showtime at the Apollo’ Co-Host, Dies at 74
item.description: Kiki Shepard, the co-host of the long-running variety show “Showtime at the Apollo,” died on Monday from a heart attack. She was 74. Shepard’s death was confirmed via her rep.
